description: rimu-ws - a fork of wtx on a thread-per-core io_uring executor (multishot accept and recv into a provided buffer ring). WebSocket echo through its WebSocketServerFramework: frames echoed straight out of the receive buffer with one vectored send per batch. HTTP/2 (h2c on :8082, h2 over TLS on :8443) through its Http2ServerFramework: HttpRouter routes, a server-header middleware, path and query extraction, JSON written per request, StaticFiles with precompressed .br/.gz variants chosen by Accept-Encoding. Library defaults plus the production guide's settings for dedicated cores (20 us spin, WebSocket only) and clients that speak first (TCP_DEFER_ACCEPT).
